BiblicalUsage: The most high God gave Nebuchadnezzar a kingdom and majesty and glory and honour, and all peoples trembled before him, yet that same greatness is promised in the end to the people of the saints of the most High.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that greatness is lent, never owned, and God gives it to whom He will and takes it when He will.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
